subject: Is it possible to have fixed prior parameters in a SPDE model?

messages.author: e879ddbc821d5625
messages.subject: Is it possible to have fixed prior parameters in a SPDE model?
parts:
Hi everyone,
I am trying to fit a SPDE models and I am setting the prior using

spde<- inla.spde2.matern(mesh,alpha=2,theta.prior.mean=c(a,b),theta.prior.prec=c(1,1))

Is it possible to actually assume that theta=c(a,b)?

Thanks
-Iav

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Is it possible to have fixed prior parameters in a SPDE model?
parts:
If you mean to fix the parameters to known values, you can specify
  B.tau=cbind(a), B.kappa=cbind(b)
and no "prior" parameter. That creates a model with no parameters, and fixed log(tau)=a and log(kappa)=b.

Finn
